json_schema.title: TS24 Event Manifest (v1)
json_schema.description: Human-authored, operator-approved definition of a single race-weekend event at rider-folder granularity. Canonical storage: 02_DATABASE/event_manifests/<event_key>.json (Phase B), mirrored into DB table event_manifest for enforcement. status transitions: draft -> approved -> active -> locked -> closed; at most ONE manifest may be 'active' at a time. After the first provisional apply, content_hash is recorded in the apply receipt; any later content change must be a new manifest_version (rewrite of the same version is rejected once locked).

schema_version.description: Version of this manifest schema itself.

manifest_version.description: Incremented on any content change. Once status is 'locked', edits are only allowed as a new manifest_version.

event_key.description: YYYYMMDD-ROUNDx-RIDER. Rider-folder granularity (matches provisional_event_key granularity, which includes the rider).

weekend_key.description: Derived weekend-level key (YYYYMMDD-ROUNDx). Distinguishes the weekend layer from the rider-folder layer.

circuit.description: Canonical circuit name. MUST match a TRACK_M key exactly.

raw_2d_root.description: Relative path from the data root. The ONLY directory a live scan may walk.

allowed_sessions.description: Whitelist of session codes acceptable for this event (e.g. FP, QP, WUP1, WUP2, RACE1, RACE2).

status.description: Lifecycle state. CHECK-constrained in the DB mirror. Invariant: at most one 'active' manifest at any time.

fingerprint_policy.description: Fingerprint tier for source files. 'content' (full sha256) is recommended for live intake to close adversarial scenario 1 (same-name same-size replacement, invisible to stat-based fingerprints).

expected_outings.description: Optional declared outing-stem set. When declared, any outing outside this set is gated (adversarial scenario 2 / P1-3).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (computed at approval, excluding this field). Stored in the first provisional-apply receipt; any later mismatch is detected as tampering and fails closed.

db_mirror_notes.event_manifest_table: Phase B-1: new table only (idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS via create_quality_tables.py pattern). Columns mirror the JSON fields + raw_json + imported_at. CHECK constraint on status enum. No ALTER of any existing table.
db_mirror_notes.event_state_ledger_table: Phase B-1: append-only ledger (never UPDATE). entry_id PK / event_key / scope CHECK(event|session|outing) / scope_id / state CHECK(discovered|registered|candidate_ready|staged|verified|reportable|finalized|failed|warning_accepted|skipped|superseded|quarantined) / prev_state / reason / actor / analysis_run_id / receipt_json / created_at.
db_mirror_notes.rollback: DROP the two new tables + delete manifest JSON files + code revert. Existing guards (§68/§69/§72/§73) remain untouched throughout Phase B, so rollback is safe.
